test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
3 and 4 from the given four alternatives. Figure 1 and 2 are related with each other in some particular way. Find the relationship and establish the same relationship between

Figure 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c9b2906e9f3b2ae0ddd3c1be95a6e7880ff56cb6db952965dcc0532d036fc68.png] 

Figure 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7265c7e8bbab3e5d8fbdef4c2b144717083238a7018e6dee68b64a887e0d2845.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In the first pair, two separate parts facing away from each other **move towards each other and combine to form a closed shape**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0f766c08c50079e60351ae7342b0283b9044e6b9f1f59549633d6fa260dcbc5.png] 

Now, checking the options:

Option 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbee986ab44eb5e17f9ae60bb859f2a0752c7fb1b1e2683a081955dcc78965ba.png] 

Complete circle – Follows the rule

Option 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17bcd79781955a770c87e02ec7cdf1530b3e7699068ce2d9ef0eb849ee65d403.png] 

Arcs joined incorrectly – Does not form proper closed shape

Option 3: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0cc6f1a13d2df16d80d57e3806ce7c5f422a59b67da1e728013d2290deb47bd.png] 

Incorrect arrangement – Does not match pattern

Option 4: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a746b0fac106ce04c1ed6939286f0a5528e4ca401e9bd756b862be089564f64.png] 

Semi-circle – Incomplete figure

Hence, **Option 1** is the correct answer.
